file_id: TheFoodInspector vs Mohd. Moizuddin on 26 June, 2023

sentences.text: The Food Inspector vs Mohd. Moizuddin on 26 June, 2023

The Honourable Sri Justice K.Surender
 Criminal Appeal No.471 of 2023
Judgment:

This Criminal Appeal is filed under Sections 378 (3) and (1) of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 (for short 'Cr.P.C.') by the appellant, to set aside the judgment dated 03.03.2011 passed in C.C.No.17 of 2008 by the learned Additional Judicial First Class Magistrate, Jangaon.

entities.text: Additional Judicial First Class Magistrate, Jangaon
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: It is case of Food Inspector that samples of Lehar 7-Up, Lehar Carbonated Water and Pepsi Cola were drawn and sent them for the purpose of analysis.
The Public Analyst opined that the samples are 'adulterated'.

Basing on the opinion of Public Analyst, the present complaint was filed by the Food Inspector against the accused for the offence under Section 16(1)(a)(i) for the Contravention of Section 2(ia)(m) and Section 7(i) of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954, vide C.C.No.17 of 2008.
4. Though the analysis report was received, there is a delay of two years in sending the analysis report and notice to the respondents - accused and the shelf life of the product is six months.
Having found that the respondents - accused have lost their right to send the sample for Central Forensic Science Laboratory, Calcutta, the learned Magistrate has acquitted the respondents - accused.
5. In view of the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case, I do not find any infirmity with the judgment passed by the learned Magistrate and the present appeal is liable to be dismissed.
6. Accordingly, the Criminal Appeal is dismissed.
Miscellaneous Petitions, pending if any, shall stand closed.

K.SURENDER, J Date: 26.06.2023 dsu/rev The Food Inspector vs Mohd. Moizuddin on 26 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/176969390/
